page_title: BHA 0-1 EVE | Brighton v Everton 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Jake O'Brien (Everton) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+10' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+10' That's it for today, Tim Robinson has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brighton.
90+5' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90+4' Brighton take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+1' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Carlos Baleba is replaced by Adam Webster (Brighton).
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
89' Brighton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' The manager makes a subsitution with Matt O'Riley (Brighton) coming on for Joel Veltman.
83' Joao Pedro (Brighton) receives a yellow card for infringement.
82' Orel Mangala (Everton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
78' David Moyes has decided to substitute Abdoulaye Doucoure and he is replaced by James Garner (Everton).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ashley Young (Everton) comes onto the pitch so that Iliman Ndiaye can be given a rest.
78' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
76' Beto (Everton) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
75' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) replacing Yasin Ayari.
74' Substitution. Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) in, Tariq Lamptey out.
74' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post.
74' A free kick on the edge of the box for Brighton. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
71' Jordan Pickford (Everton) gets a yellow card. The referee Tim Robinson made the right call.
69' So close! Georginio Rutter (Brighton) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
66' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:2.
64' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
62' The game has come to an end for Jesper Lindstrom. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nathan Patterson (Everton).
62' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
62' Brighton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
61' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
61' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Brighton.
57' The corner is swung in but Brighton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
55' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Brighton.
52' The linesman raises his flag. Beto (Everton) is adjudged offside.
50' CLOSE! Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post!
49' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
48' A rebound sits up perfectly for Joel Veltman (Brighton), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Fabian Hurzeler probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Brajan Gruda. He is replaced by Georginio Rutter (Brighton).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
45+2' It seemed like Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
45+2' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45' We will have 7 min. of added time.
43' The expression of the referee Tim Robinson is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) is shown a yellow card.
42' 0 - 1 Goal! Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Bart Verbruggen into the bottom left corner.
42' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) is going to take the penalty!
41' The main referee, Tim Robinson, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) is given a yellow card for dissent.
40' Referee Tim Robinson is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Everton!
39' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Everton using VAR. Let's see what happens.
38' That looked a certain handball by Joel Veltman (Brighton) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
37' The Everton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
33' It seemed like Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
32' The ball is cleared after Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
29' Brighton are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
28' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
27' Joao Pedro (Brighton) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
26' Tim Robinson blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) brought his opponent down.
25' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
24' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) and Jarrad Branthwaite matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
22' 62:38 – the latest ball possession ratio.
18' The Brighton players are exchanging some short passes.
15' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
13' Problems for David Moyes as Dominic Calvert-Lewin is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Beto (Everton) replaces him.
11' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
11' Joao Pedro (Brighton) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar.
7' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
4' A mistake by a defender gifts Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes well wide of the right post.
3' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The match has just started.
Brighton will kick-off.
Tim Robinson will referee today's match.
